Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap Classic pools.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap Classic pools.

Revenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: The 1/6 protocol fee share from SushiSwap Classic swaps.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: The 1/6 protocol fee share from SushiSwap Classic swaps.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: The 5/6 fee share retained by liquidity providers.

Fees.Deposit/Withdraw Fees: Flat native-token fee charged when a recipient claims from a Lockup stream, a Flow stream, or an airdrop campaign

Revenue.Claim Fees To Treasury: The whole claim fee; none of it is shared with LPs, stream creators, or integrators

ProtocolRevenue.Claim Fees To Treasury: Swept to the Sablier treasury via the comptroller

Fees.LP management fees: Performance and management fees charged on liquidity provider positions managed by Gamma across all integrated DEXs

Revenue.Protocol revenue: All management fees collected are retained by Gamma Protocol

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol revenue: All management fees collected are retained by Gamma Protocol

Fees.Relayer Fees: Fees paid to relayers who execute cross-chain bridge transactions on the destination chain
Fees.LP Fees: Fees paid to liquidity providers who supply capital for cross-chain transfers

SupplySideRevenue.Relayer Fees: Fees paid to relayers who execute cross-chain bridge transactions on the destination chain
SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: Fees paid to liquidity providers who supply capital for cross-chain transfers

Fees.Partner Fees: Fee collected by the PartnerFeeCollector on each routed swap.
Fees.Octopool Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the octopools on both sides of a swap, read from the FeeCollected event.
Fees.Bridging Fees: stableBridgingFee deducted on the destination leg of a transfer, on the mint leg from the Synthesis contract and on the unlock leg from the Portal contract.

Revenue.Partner Fees To Symbiosis: Partner fees collected by the symbiosis owned fee address.
Revenue.Octopool Swap Fees To Protocol: Share of the octopool swap fee sent to the protocol fee receiver, one minus lpDividendRatio.
Revenue.Bridging Fees To Bridge: The whole bridging fee, minted or transferred to the BridgeV2 contract which only the owner or admin can withdraw from.

ProtocolRevenue.Partner Fees To Symbiosis: Partner fees collected by the symbiosis owned fee address.
ProtocolRevenue.Octopool Swap Fees To Protocol: Share of the octopool swap fee sent to the protocol fee receiver, one minus lpDividendRatio.
ProtocolRevenue.Bridging Fees To Bridge: The whole bridging fee, minted or transferred to the BridgeV2 contract which only the owner or admin can withdraw from.

SupplySideRevenue.Partner Fees To Partners: Partner fees claimed by the partner that routed the swap.
SupplySideRevenue.Octopool Swap Fees To LPs: Share of the octopool swap fee kept by the liquidity providers, lpDividendRatio.

Fees.Transaction Gas Fees: Gas fees paid by users for cross-chain contract calls, express calls, and with-token calls through Axelar bridge
Fees.Gas Refunds: Refunds issued to users when transactions fail or gas is overpaid (shown as negative to reduce total fees)

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap V3 pools. Fee rates vary by pool, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap V3 pools. Fee rates vary by pool, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The part of each swap fee Sushi keeps - 25% where the protocol fee is switched on, 50% on Katana.
Revenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: Protocol fee share routed to xSUSHI stakers through the SushiBar flow (Negligible since Mid of October 2025).

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The part of each swap fee Sushi keeps, collected into a Sushi-controlled treasury wallet on each chain.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: Swap fees retained by liquidity providers after protocol fees.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: Protocol fee share routed to xSUSHI stakers through the SushiBar flow (Negligible since Mid of October 2025).

Fees.Bridge Fees: the relaying fee charged on each bridge transfer

Revenue.Bridge Fees: the relaying fee charged on each bridge transfer

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees: 0.85% of the volume is protocol revenue
ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees: the relaying fee charged on each bridge transfer

Fees.Trading Fees: Trading fees charged on each trade executed through Banana Gun bot.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Trading fees collected by Banana Gun protocol.

Fees.Option Purchase Fees: Protocol fee charged on top of the option premium at purchase (fixed % of premium per market, set in the CLAMM FeeStrategy).

Revenue.Option Purchase Fees To Protocol: The full protocol fee is transferred to the Stryke feeTo address.

Fees.ETH Staking Rewards: Total ETH staking rewards from EigenLayer restaking across all chains.
Fees.EIGEN Token Rewards: EIGEN token rewards distributed from EigenLayer reward distributor.
Fees.agETH Management Fees: Management fees (2%) collected from agETH vault in rsETH tokens.
Fees.hgETH Management Fees: Management fees (1.5%) collected from hgETH vault in rsETH tokens.
Fees.hgETH Performance Fees: Performance fees (20%) collected from positive rate delta in hgETH vault.

SupplySideRevenue.ETH Staking Rewards: ETH staking rewards distributed to rsETH holders after protocol fees.
SupplySideRevenue.EIGEN Token Rewards: EIGEN token rewards distributed to rsETH holders after protocol fees.

Revenue.ETH Staking Rewards: Protocol share of ETH staking rewards at the on-chain protocol fee rate.
Revenue.EIGEN Token Rewards: Protocol fees from EIGEN token rewards.
Revenue.agETH Management Fees: Management fees (2%) collected from agETH vault.
Revenue.hgETH Management Fees: Management fees (1.5%) collected from hgETH vault.
Revenue.hgETH Performance Fees: Performance fees (20%) from positive rate delta in hgETH vault.

ProtocolRevenue.ETH Staking Rewards: Protocol share of ETH staking rewards at the on-chain protocol fee rate.
ProtocolRevenue.EIGEN Token Rewards: Protocol fees from EIGEN token rewards.
ProtocolRevenue.agETH Management Fees: Management fees (2%) collected from agETH vault.
ProtocolRevenue.hgETH Management Fees: Management fees (1.5%) collected from hgETH vault.
ProtocolRevenue.hgETH Performance Fees: Performance fees (20%) from positive rate delta in hgETH vault.

Fees.Borrow Interest: Interest paid by borrowers for loans, with approximately 85-90% distributed to lenders

Revenue.Reserve Accumulation: Portion of borrow interest accumulated in pool reserves, approximately 10-15% of total interest, held for future token burns

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest: Interest distributed to lenders who supply liquidity to lending pools

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: AJNA token burns that reduce circulating supply, benefiting all token holders

Fees.Swap Fees: Protocol fee routed to fly.trade's fee collector.
Fees.Affiliate Fees: Fee routed to affiliate / integrator addresses.
Fees.Surplus: Positive slippage retained by fly.trade's router (capped at maxRetentionBps).

SupplySideRevenue.Affiliate Fees: Fees paid out to affiliates / integrators.

Fees.Protocol Fees: Includes 1% of the fees for Moon Or Doom and YOLO winnings, and a 3% fee on Poke The Bear winnings.

Revenue.Token Buy Back: Includes 20% of the fees going to token buybacks.
Revenue.Protocol Fees to Treasury: Includes 30% of the fees going to the protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees to Treasury: Includes 30% of the fees going to the protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Rake Back to Players: Includes 45% of the fees going to the rake back to players.
SupplySideRevenue.Protocol Fees to Lottery: Includes 5% of the fees going to the protocol fees to the lottery.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Includes 20% of the fees going to token buybacks.

Fees.DVN_FEES: Native token fees paid to required and optional DVNs that verify cross-chain messages.
Fees.EXECUTOR_FEES: Native token fees paid to Executors that deliver and execute messages on the destination chain.

Revenue.Token Buy Back: ZRO bought back using Stargate ecosystem revenue.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: ZRO bought back and distributed to holders.

Fees.Referral commissions: Commission each OKX router records on the swaps it routes, counted in whichever token the commission was taken in.

UserFees.Referral commissions: The same commissions, which are paid by the user out of the swap.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral commissions: Every commission is booked against the referrer that brought the trade, so all of it is supply side.

Fees.Swap Fees: Swap fees charged on v2 SuperSwap routes: 0.25% for in-chain swaps and 0.35% for cross-chain portal swaps.

UserFees.Swap Fees: Fees paid by users on v2 SuperSwap routes.

Fees.Bridge Fees: Fees on bridges, including swaps before bridging.
Fees.Other Fees: Fees that could not be matched to a swap or a bridge.

Revenue.LiFi Fees: Share of fees kept by LI.FI.

ProtocolRevenue.LiFi Fees: Share of fees kept by LI.FI.

SupplySideRevenue.Integration & Partnership Fees: Share of fees paid to integrators, including Jumper since 2026-08-07.

Revenue.LiFi Fees: Share of fees kept by LI.FI.

ProtocolRevenue.LiFi Fees: Share of fees kept by LI.FI.

SupplySideRevenue.Integration & Partnership Fees: Share of fees paid to integrators, including Jumper since 2026-08-07.

Fees.Platform Fees: Fee charged by Rango on each swap or cross-chain transfer.
Fees.Affiliate Fees: Fee charged on behalf of the integrator that routed the transaction.
Fees.Destination Executor Fees: Fee covering execution costs on the destination chain.

Revenue.Platform Fees to Protocol: Platform fees are kept by Rango.

ProtocolRevenue.Platform Fees to Protocol: Platform fees are kept by Rango.

SupplySideRevenue.Affiliate Fees to Affiliates: Affiliate fees are paid out to the integrator that routed the transaction.
SupplySideRevenue.Destination Executor Fees: Destination executor fees are paid to executors that complete the transfer on the destination chain.

Fees.Swap Fees: Fees paid by users on Gate Swap routes.

UserFees.Swap Fees: Fees paid directly by Gate Swap users.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Swap fees retained by Gate Swap.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Swap fees allocated to the Gate Swap protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Integrators: Swap fees paid to integrators, referrers, or other route suppliers.

Fees.Randomness Service Fees: Total fees paid per Entropy randomness request. Fee = Provider fee (dynamic, covers gas) + Protocol fee (set by Pyth DAO governance).

Revenue.Randomness Service Fees To Pyth DAO: Protocol fees collected by Pyth DAO treasury per randomness request.

SupplySideRevenue.Randomness Service Fees To Providers: Provider fees paid to randomness providers for fulfilling requests (includes gas cost reimbursement).

Fees.Aggregator Fees: Aggregator fees paid by users for the swaps.

UserFees.Aggregator Fees: Aggregator fees paid by users for the swaps.

Revenue.Aggregator Fees to Protocol: Part of the aggregator fees that is retained by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Aggregator Fees to Protocol: Part of the aggregator fees that is retained by the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Aggregator Fees to Liquidity Providers: Part of the aggregator fees that is paid to the liquidity providers.

Fees.Bridge Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.

UserFees.Bridge Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.

Revenue.Bridge Fees to Protocol: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees to Protocol: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees to Providers: Fees paid to underlying bridge and relayer providers.

UserFees.Interchain Gas Payments: User paid fees from Hyperlane InterchainGasPaymaster.

SupplySideRevenue.Interchain Gas Payments: Gross IGP payments to non-Hyperlane relayer contracts when present.

Revenue.Interchain Gas Payments: Gross IGP payments to Hyperlane-published relayer contracts.

ProtocolRevenue.Interchain Gas Payments: Gross IGP payments to Hyperlane-published relayer contracts.

Fees.Oracle Service Fees: Fees paid by users to update Pyth price feeds on-chain. Fee amounts per chain are set by Pyth DAO governance via singleUpdateFeeInWei() on each contract.

Revenue.Oracle Service Fees To Pyth Treasury: All update fees accrue to the Pyth protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Oracle Service Fees To Pyth Treasury: All update fees accrue to the Pyth protocol treasury.

Fees.Cube Minting Fees: Total fees paid by users when minting Cube NFTs.

Revenue.Cube Minting Fees to Treasury: Portion of the Cube minting fee retained by the Layer3 treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Cube Minting Fees to Treasury: Portion of the Cube minting fee retained by the Layer3 treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Cube Minting Fees to Creators and Referr: Portion of the Cube minting fee paid out to creators, publishers, and referrers.

Fees.Service Fees: Native fees paid out to relayers, oracles, and treasury via WithdrawNative.
Fees.Protocol Fees: ZRO protocol fees withdrawn from UltraLightNodeV2 by the V1 Treasury contract via WithdrawZRO.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: ZRO protocol fees moved to the V1 Treasury contract.

SupplySideRevenue.Service Fees: Native fees paid out to relayers and oracles.

Fees.Integrator Fees: A 0.25% integrator fee is charged on the input token of every swap routed through DropSwap, recorded per chain in DropSwap's own database.

Revenue.Integrator Fees to Token Buybacks: Part of integrator fees used to fund $DROP buybacks and burns.
Revenue.Integrator Fees to Protocol: Part of integrator fees retained by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Integrator Fees to Protocol: Part of integrator fees retained by the protocol.

HoldersRevenue.Integrator Fees to Token Buybacks: Part of integrator fees used to fund $DROP buybacks and burns.

SupplySideRevenue.Integrator Fees to Swap Campaigns: Part of integrator fees used to fund swap campaigns.
